correctness.rationale: Exhaustive triangle partition gives exact simplicial decomposition X=Delta_R cup_I(D_m*I) plus isolated hub-hub edges. Simplicial cofibrations and the equivariant fixed-barycenter contraction yield A equivariantly homotopy equivalent to D_{m+1}*I; connected I makes A simply connected. Attaching choose(m,2) edges produces that many circles and no cells above degree one. Join homology over Z gives the higher tensor module with free augmentation lattice, and relative chain LES gives exterior-square integral H1. Reconstructible independently from included triangle-enumerating checker; its finite F2 checks support but are not substituted for proof.
